_notes: Day job, fatigue and weather. Source: GAME_DESIGN.md sections 10-11 + Oscar's answers. Values in _picked were chosen by Claude as placeholders (Oscar: tweak freely). Everything else is from GAME_DESIGN.md or Oscar's Phase 1 answers.

dayJob._notes: A3 (idle arcade): at shiftStart on workdays you drive off to the county shed. The clock fast-forwards (fastForward x game speed) to shiftEnd while you're away; anything automated (workers, Jean Claude docks, rigs already rendering) keeps working, nothing you run by hand moves. Then a 'Welcome home' summary. The paycheck is paid at the end of the Friday shift: paystub.json grossPay minus withholding and 1-2 random county deductions (a pay stub in Welcome home). weeklyPay is the typical take-home, the bar the business has to beat to quit. Quit the Day Job: when business income (job cash collected minus wages) beats weeklyPay for quitUnlock.weeksAboveInARow paydays in a row, a price pad (quitUnlock.price) appears by the office; paying it ends shifts, callouts and the paycheck for good. Storm callouts: on winter nights at rollHour, chancePerNight of being called out for hoursMin-hoursMax game hours, paid overtimePayPerHour.

weather.name: Rain
weather.blurb: Flights 50% slower and a 5 s dry-off after landing (weatherproofing ignores both)

weather.name: Showers
weather.blurb: Passing showers pause takeoffs for a few seconds

weather.name: Fog
weather.blurb: Fog banks pause takeoffs for a few seconds

weather.name: Snow
weather.blurb: Flights 25% slower (heated batteries ignore it), thermal +15%

weather.name: Extreme Cold
weather.blurb: Flights 40% slower (heated batteries ignore it), thermal +25%

seasonPay._notes: A3: pay bonus (or cut) by drone type for jobs delivered in that season, on top of which jobs show up (jobs.json seasons).

_weatherNotes: A6 (Oscar): never a dead day. Full-day bad weather (rain, snow, extreme cold) is about 1 day in 10 in every season. Rain: flights 50% slower plus a dry-off after each landing, both skipped with the weatherproofing part. Showers and fog only pause takeoffs now and then (pauses.everySec / pauseSec). Workers keep working in any weather.

crewTexts._notes: A6 (Oscar): after you quit the day job, now and then a text from the old county shed crew shows on the HUD. Every everyGameDaysMin-Max game days (a game day is 3 real minutes). All names fictional. Add lines freely.
lines: Supervisors bought new tires again. Glad you got out.
They put your old grader up for auction. Nobody knows how to run it.
Farmer on 180th says the road's worse since you left.
They're studying the gravel budget again.
